_source: Curated findings from web search + page fetches run 2026-08-14.
_rule: Every entry below was seen literally in a search-result title/URL or in a page fetched this session. Nothing here is recalled from model memory. Where a fact could not be verified it is null, never guessed.
_why_curated: Search is not scriptable, so this hand-checked file IS the reproducibility record for the search layer — same pattern as the hand-curated gazetteer in scripts/crm/sudan-places.ts. The generator reads it; it is never machine-overwritten.

businesses.area: Khartoum-based; actively markets Port Sudan stock across حي المطار, حي الخليج and سلالاب
businesses.note: A real brokerage actively marketing Port Sudan furnished apartments — daily/monthly/yearly terms, viewing videos on request. Phones and socials are published verbatim in its own post captions. The neighbourhood pass strengthened this materially: its Facebook page (facebook.com/sdamhe.sanhesan, confirmed by fetch to be أملاك العقارية) posts Port Sudan inventory by named district — حي المطار مربع ٤ on شارع السلك, حي الخليج on the main street — and it is listing a four-storey building for sale in سلالاب on alsoug.com. So: headquartered in Khartoum, but genuinely trading Port Sudan stock rather than merely reposting it. Still classified as a channel into the city, not an office in it, until someone confirms a local branch.

The detail page could NOT be fetched — the site began returning HTTP 403 mid-sweep. Name is inferred from the URL slug, category is unknown. Flagged review_required rather than dropped, because the URL is hard evidence the record exists.

businesses.note: The dominant broker on alsoug's Port Sudan property board: advertiser uid 311171 holds **8 of the 12** Port Sudan real-estate ads listed there. Self-described as 'صاحبة شركة تسويق الكتروني — Global Real Estate Marketer' (owner of a digital-marketing company). Posts under two display names — an older 'Hana Abrahim' and the current Arabic form — but the same numeric account id, which is how they were resolved to one advertiser rather than two. Attribution was verified in-browser: every data-user_name element on an advert page carries that page's own data-advert_id, so this is not a related-ads widget bleeding into the parse. No phone is exposed — alsoug puts contact behind a chat button — so reaching them means the platform's own contact flow or a login. Inventory reaches well beyond apartments: one listing is a 15-room, 8-bathroom two-storey building in ديم مدينة غرب at US$4,000/month.

alsoug.com publishes neighbourhood-scoped rental indexes for Port Sudan (سلالاب, ترانزيت, حي المطار) — real supply, but individual landlord ads, not businesses. Catalogued as a channel, not crawled ad-by-ad.

Demand signal worth carrying: the largest Port Sudan rental ad found is a 15-room building at US$4,000/month advertised explicitly 'لاصحاب الشركات والمنظمات والمؤسسات والمكاتب والمستوصفات' — to companies, NGOs, institutions, offices and clinics. Port Sudan's rental demand is currently organisational relocation, not tourism, and it is priced in USD.

The classifieds broker layer is thin and concentrated: of 12 Port Sudan property ads on alsoug, one advertiser holds 8 and the rest are one-off individual sellers (Abu Salem, Nahla Abdalbdea, قباني). Individual sellers were deliberately NOT added as businesses — they are a different unit of work.

_alias_bridges_why: Cross-script duplicates cannot be matched algorithmically — 'فندق اوكير' and 'Okere Hotel' share no characters. These pairs were each confirmed by hand against coordinates and category before being written here. The generator merges ONLY on this list plus hard signals (same phone / same domain); anything else that merely looks close is soft-linked for a human, never merged.
